summary: An AnsibleCredential CR creates a Machine credential (ssh_username, ssh_secret) or an Amazon Web Services credential (username_secret, password_secret) with connection_secret and organization.
questions: How do I create an SSH credential with the Resource Operator?
Create a Machine credential from a Kubernetes secret

answer_card.title: AnsibleCredential examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: tower.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleCredential
metadata:
  name: ssh-cred
spec:
  name: ssh-cred
  organization: Default
  connection_secret: aap-access
  type: "Machine"
  ssh_username: "cat"
  ssh_secret: my-ssh-secret
```
AWS: `type: "Amazon Web Services"` with `username_secret` and `password_secret`.
